title: Protestors camp outside Goldman Sachs HQ
description: Dozens of protestors have gathered outside the Lower Manhattan headquarters of Goldman Sachs, the investment bank, following a series of appointments of Goldman-linked people to top jobs in the Trump administration. Ben McLannahan reports  ► Subscribe to FT.com here: http://on.ft.com/2eZZoLI  ► Subscribe to the Financial Times on YouTube: http://bit.ly/FTimeSubs  For more video content from the Financial Times, visit http://www.FT.com/video   Twitter https://twitter.com/ftvideo Facebook https://www.facebook.com/financialtimes

asr.full_text: The president elects! The president elects! Who is not my president! Brands! To train! The swamp!!! I'm here outside the lower Manhattan headquarters of Goldman Sachs, the giant investment bank, where protesters are gathered to decry what they see as two strong links between Washington and Wall Street. It was only a couple of months ago on the campaign trail that Donald Trump used Goldman Sachs as a symbol of corporate greed and attacked Hillary Clinton's close ties to the bank in the form of all those speeches that she gave for hundreds of thousands of dollars a time. But since the election Mr. Trump has moved to appoint a series of Goldman Sachs insider to senior positions within his administration so these people are looking at what Donald Trump said on the campaign trail and what he's since done with his Appointments and they're asking is this guy much too close to Goldman Sachs? We're trying to send a message get get media attention I assume I'm not one of the organisers of this I'm not a leader at all I just showed up because I saw something on Facebook Him putting in all these Goldman Sachs people, a complete betrayal to the American people, to the people that voted for him. He's betraying the very people that voted for him. I didn't vote for him, but if I did, I'd be pissed. He's completely disloyal to these Americans that did vote for him, and disloyal to me as just a fellow American. Goldman Sachs has intimate connections with the pharmaceutical industry and the private health insurance industry and those industries are exploited the health and lives of my patients. I worked in New York for the last six years working in mostly poor communities with people of color immigrants, people with HIV and homeless people, LGBT people, and I see every day how the health care system the way it's designed, is designed to create profits and not necessarily create health care. Our backs are kind of up against the wall like we see that people like Steve Mnuchin right, they make a living for closing on families, they're gonna be running our government, sleeping outside is just it's a small gesture as to what I'm willing to do to protect my family, right, to protect other New Yorkers and to really stand up for American values. It's not a huge demonstration behind me, but is a colorful one. There's people dressed in swamp Monster costumes, and the process has shut down at least two of the three entrances into Golden Sacks Headquarters, and these guys are going to be here for at least another night. They are camping out in these very cold and wet conditions. What they want is for Goldman Sachs to be less of an influence for Donald Trump. Ben McLenahan, Financial Times, New York.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a Financial Times news report about protesters outside Goldman Sachs headquarters and criticism of perceived Washington-Wall Street ties. The speech and visuals concern protest messaging, interviews, and a political demand, rather than an offer requiring payment, credentials, investment, or participation in a money-making scheme. The subscription link is ordinary publisher promotion for more content, not a condition for a financial benefit or a deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is financial and political news reporting about Goldman Sachs, government appointments and perceived Washington-Wall Street relationships, rather than an offer, investment solicitation or money-making mechanism.
